thread:
sophia tan: Quick sync: getting Redwood Dedicated into AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. We need a one-page onboarding checklist for vendor docs + exact artifact names. Can owners chime in with current blockers?

devin park: Blocking: confirmed we need a publisher account invite on each marketplace and tenant-level billing contact. Also need final AMI/image names and container image tags for registry ingestion.

sophia tan: Devin can you paste staging image names? Also upload path conventions so partnerships can forward to marketplaces.

devin park: Staging artifacts:

- AWS AMI: ami-0b1a2c3d4e5f67890 (tag: redwood-dedicated-stg-v1)
- AWS container: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/dedicated:stg-202603
- GCP image: projects/redwood-marketplace/images/redwood-dedicated-stg-202603
- Azure image: redwood-dedicated-stg-vhd-202603.vhd (storage account: redwoodmarketplacestg)

melissa wong: Legal checklist I need: signed Marketplace Publisher Agreement (AWS/Azure/GCP), EULA with trial terms, data processing addendum, and tax forms (W-9/W-8). Also need a public contact and privacy policy URL.

arjun singh: Product-packaging notes: SKU ids proposed: RWI-DEDI-PAYG, RWI-DEDI-YR, RWI-DEDI-ENT. Each SKU needs meter dimensions and short/long descriptions. Trial metadata: trial_length_days=14, trial_limit_units=1, trial_only=false.

sophia tan: Marketing asks for hero 1200x600 PNG, 3 screenshots 1280x720, and short tagline <= 140 chars. Also localized description for en-US and en-GB.

devin park: Ops: give us a service account for upload with least privilege. Proposed IAM snippet for AWS (short):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:PutObject","ec2:RegisterImage","ec2:DescribeImages"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }]
}
```

melissa wong: Finance: need price tiers and currency support. Also marketplace fee handling preference (gross vs net). @finance-bot can you confirm standard marketplace fee passthrough?

finance-bot: Standard passthrough = marketplace retained fees deducted by platform. Submit billing contact and bank details via secure form: https://redwood.pay/forms/marketplace-payouts

arjun singh: QA window proposed: 2026-03-30 09:00-11:00 PT in staging accounts. Need sign-off by Legal and Product by 2026-03-29 COB.

sophia tan: Action items: Devin attach AMI/container/image manifests to PLAT-900. Melissa attach signed legal PDFs. Arjun finalize SKU mapping and sample meter. I'll coordinate invites to publisher consoles. Please dump artifacts into PLAT-900 comments.

melissa wong: Will do. tagging folks in the ticket after uploads.

devin park: Uploads done, commented. tagging @sophia for publisher invites.

sophia tan: Thanks — I'll schedule the QA slot and send calendar invites. :thumbsup:
